sample_description: anatase TiO2 coating grown by nanosecond fiber-laser (1064 nm) surface oxidation in O2 (Table 1 anatase parameters: 12.5 W, 400 mm/s, 20 kHz, 0% pulse overlap), on wrought Ti-6Al-4V (TAV)
conditions: laser-processed in O2 at room temperature (anatase parameter set, Table 1)
notes: paper: "Anatase samples showed clear Raman peaks at 145, 198, 399, 516, and 638 cm-1" (no mode assignment); rutile 241/445/610 skipped; text adds that the transformation quality was similar on additive TAV, CP Ti Grade 4 and pure Ti
